description: Install dependencies and verify the project builds successfully as a baseline before making changes.
steps: Run npx prisma generate to produce the Prisma client in src/generated/prisma/
Run npm run build and confirm it completes without errors
acceptance_criteria: npx prisma generate produces client files in src/generated/prisma/
npm run build exits with code 0
verification: npm run build exits with code 0
findings: Build succeeds cleanly. npm install runs prisma generate as postinstall automatically. Node 22 and npm 11.4.2 are available. No test framework - verification is build-only. 16 npm audit vulnerabilities (1 moderate, 15 high) but these are pre-existing and do not affect build.
